extracted.intended_audience: wholesale lumber dealers, contractors, and retail customers of Adelman Lumber Company
extracted.subtask_description: A 1934 dealers' price list and terms from Adelman Lumber Company covering payment terms, freight and bundling rules, returns, alteration charges, and detailed product/pricing specifications for windows, doors, mouldings and other building materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local shipment payment terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Accounts must be settled on or before the 10th of the month following date of shipment by cash, less 2% on net amount of invoice after deducting freight, or by 60 Day note dated the first day of the month following date of shipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If not settled according to above terms accounts are due NET 30 Days after the 1st of the month following date of shipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carload shipment payment terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Accounts must be settled within 5 Days after arrival of car either by cash less 2% on net amount of invoice after deducting freight, or by 60 Day note bearing date of shipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interest on past due accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: Interest at the rate of 6% will be charged on all past due accounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freight allowance threshold and exceptions
rubrics_metrics.description: FREIGHT ALLOWED ON SHIPMENTS OF 200 POUNDS OR MORE EXCEPT On Items Marked 'No Freight Allowance'. Shipments of Less than 200 Pounds ARE F.O.B. Pittsburgh or Shipping Point.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Freight allowance will be made only on rates in effect at this time; any advance in freight rates or any taxes assessed or levied by Federal or State Government must be absorbed by the customer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freight claims and receipted freight bills requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: NO FREIGHT WILL BE ALLOWED unless receipted freight bills reach us within 60 Days from date of shipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Company liability for goods damaged in transit
rubrics_metrics.description: Our responsibility ceases when delivery is made to Carrier and Clear Receipt delivered to us. We do not guarantee delivery or make delivered price, but we allow freight at Tariff rate on Actual Weight; hence we are not responsible for errors, overcharges, shortage or damage to stock in transit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Company will assist customers in collecting freight claims when possible provided damage is noted on freight receipt.

rubrics_metrics.name: Returns policy (with permission)
rubrics_metrics.description: When stock items of merchandise are returned in good order we will credit at purchase price less 20%, but customer must pay all freight and bundling charges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No credit given on returned odd or special items. Orders for odd work cannot be cancelled after work is started.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prices subject to change
rubrics_metrics.description: All Prices Subject to Change Without Notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: No allowance on materials called for at warehouse
rubrics_metrics.description: No allowance made on materials called for at our warehouse.

rubrics_metrics.name: No reverse telephone calls
rubrics_metrics.description: No rererse telephone calls can be accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bundling — no charge for full bundle lots
rubrics_metrics.description: NO BUNDLING charged when orders are for full bundle lots (EXCEPT FOR COMBINATION AND SCREEN DOORS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When orders are for less than full bundles specified charges will be made (see bundling charges schedule).

rubrics_metrics.name: Bundling charges schedule (doors & windows)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific bundling charges apply when orders are less than full bundles: DOORS — Softwood Panel and Open Sash Doors Per Bundle $1.20; Softwood Glazed Doors $2.00; Hardwood Doors $2.00; Garage Doors Per Pair or Set $2.00; Slab and V Cut Doors — 3 Doors or Less $2.00; Cupboard Doors $0.50; Softwood Doors cleated on ends only $0.50. WINDOWS AND SASH — Open Windows and Sash Per Bundle $0.50; Glazed, Under 60 United Inches $0.50; Glazed, Over 60 United Inches $1.00.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For crating charges on Combination Doors SEE PAGE 31; Screen Doors SEE PAGE 30.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bundle quantities by product and thickness
rubrics_metrics.description: Doors and windows are bundled in set counts depending on type and thickness (examples: SOFTWOOD PANEL DOORS: 10 Doors A" Thick; 7 Doors W' Thick; 6 Doors 1%" Thick; 4 Doors 1%" Thick; 12 Cupboard Doors H" or 1 y s " Thick). WINDOWS: Open Windows 1y8" and Thick 5 to a Bundle; Open Sash 1H" and 1%" Thick 10 to a Bundle; Glazed Windows 1%" Thick 6 to a Bundle; Glazed Sash 1y8" Thick 12 to a Bundle, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Page 3 for Full Bundle Quantities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Made-to-order items marked ★
rubrics_metrics.description: Items marked ★ are made to order from K. D.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also: 'Can Also Furnish Western Openings.' and 'Sizes Marked X Also carried in Western Openings.' — indicates alternate opening/stock origin options for windows/sash.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alteration charges for stock doors (trim/remove panels/divide lights)
rubrics_metrics.description: EXTRA FOR ALTERING STOCK DOORS: Trimming top or bottom rail to reduce height $0.50; Removing panel from two panel doors to make 1 light including glass beads $2.00; Removing panels from cross panel doors to make 1 light including glass beads $2.50; Pine doors with one light — divided into square lights including glass bead, per light $0.70; Hardwood doors with one light — divided into square lights including glass bead, per light $1.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extra charges to reduce height or width of stock doors
rubrics_metrics.description: EXTRA FOR ALTERING STOCK DOORS TO REDUCE HEIGHT: One light sash doors $2.50; One panel and two panel doors $2.50; Inner-Frame doors $5.00; One panel cupboard doors $1.00. EXTRA FOR ALTERING STOCK DOORS TO REDUCE WIDTH: One panel and two panel doors $3.50; Five cross panel doors $8.00; Inner-Frame doors $5.50; One panel cupboard doors $1.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Half-window billing rules
rubrics_metrics.description: When either the top or bottom sash of any stock two, four or twelve light window is ordered it will be billed at one-half the price shown for a full window PLUS $0.40.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The top sash of Windows with divided lights will be billed at one half the price shown for a full two light window plus for three vertical lights $1.12, plus for six square lights $1.66.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special-surcharge rules for unspecified sizes
rubrics_metrics.description: For sizes not shown above, use stock two light window list and Add $0.72 (or Add $1.20 for other listings); similarly 'For sizes not shown above, use stock two light window list and Add $1.20' appears in other sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies per-product as noted (see the particular window listing where 'For sizes not shown above' appears).

rubrics_metrics.name: No freight allowance on certain product categories
rubrics_metrics.description: No Freight Allowance is specified for certain product categories (explicit examples: 'No Freight Allowance on Shingles'; 'No Freight Allowance on Gutter'; 'No Freight Allowance on Mantels or Shelves'; 'No Freight Allowance on Pickets').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where 'No Freight Allowance' is stated the customer must bear freight cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Surcharges for specified/longer lengths and small orders
rubrics_metrics.description: For Specified Lengths Add 10% to Above Prices; For orders less than 200 feet of any Moulding, add 10%. For Hardwood Mouldings, l%" and lA" thick, add 25% to above prices. For orders for Hardwood Mouldings and Odd Mouldings in any wood less than 500 feet of a size and kind, add $3.00 each set-up. For specified lengths add 10%.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also: For Specified Lengths Add 10% appears repeatedly (e.g., gutters, mouldings, stile/top rail lengths).

rubrics_metrics.name: Extras for cutting/ripping and special tooling
rubrics_metrics.description: Odd Moulding Extras: Cut to lengths or specified lengths, add 15%. Bits for special designs, $3.00 per inch. Add A" for ripping all Hardwood Mouldings under 1%". Add for ripping all Hardwood Mouldings over 1%".
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These extras apply in addition to base moulding price and small-order/setup charges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rabbeting and pair-work extras
rubrics_metrics.description: Rabbeting Doors for Pairs $0.30 Per Pair Extra.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manufacturer's option on finishing/details
rubrics_metrics.description: Some product finish and sticking choices are at the company's option (examples: 'Cross Panel Doors Have Raised Panel One Side, Flat Panel One Side or Raised Panel Two Sides Our Option.'; 'Cupboard Doors Have O. G. or Bead Sticking Our Option.'; 'Bead & C. or C. & B. Sticking Our Option.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These options indicate the company may choose the specific finish/sticking without further notice.
